title: THE PILLBOX REDESIGN
why: His order of 2026-10-12: improve the sprites of all characters and machines, silhouettes first. The Pillbox was a purple drum with seven lilac bubbles and a black porthole: the pipes read as candles, the mouth as a speaker, and purple is the elite colour. Now it is a gunmetal emplacement on a bolted plinth with rusty sandbags at its corners, a rust band round its drum, a crown of seven brass organ pipes on top that still slowly turns, and a big round port with a six-blade iris that opens when it wakes and charges red inside (orange when it vents, dim white asleep). Venting heat now rises from the pipe tops. Elite Pillboxes wear a brass ring round the crown. Drawn only: the mouth is where its weak point is, and the fight is unchanged.
now: The Pillbox is redrawn: a gunmetal emplacement with a crown of brass organ pipes and an iris mouth that charges red.
